dedupe_keys.name: ribuild energy saving potential lca and lcc case studies

description: RIBuild partners publish inputs and outputs from desk-based building-energy assessments in Denmark, Latvia and Italy, together with life-cycle assessment and life-cycle costing analyses of an Italian case. The source identifies national building-simulation tools for the energy-saving assessments and links project tasks on energy, environmental impacts and costs. The 22 native file descriptors include spreadsheets, archives, text, documents and model-specific files. Zenodo provides the bundle freely under CC BY 4.0. These are case-study analysis data, not a census of realised retrofit savings. A limitation is that the descriptive metadata does not enumerate simulation horizons, calculation steps or all monetary and environmental units. The related RIBuild historic-building survey describes renovation cases at a broader level; sharing project cases does not make its survey and these explicit simulation-output files interchangeable. No model was executed and no claimed savings were independently checked.
